# B2B Quant, Regulatory Compliance, FinTech & SecOps Suite (@b2b-quant-apis)

> Production suite of **31 Stateless B2B Regulatory Compliance, KYB, Sanctions AML, GovCon (SAM.gov / EU TED / Brazil PNCP), SEC EDGAR, UK Companies House/FCA, US OSHA, SSL/TLS CT Attack Surface, Healthcare (ClinicalTrials.gov / OpenFDA / NPI / TISS), and Brazil Central Bank (BCB / PIX / CNPJ / IBGE / Tax Reform) Engines**.
> Available via **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**, **Apify Store Pay-Per-Event**, **37 n8n Workflows**, **Agensi.io Skill Packs**, and **x402 Solana USDC (`DuaKjymBXrmawGgg5gK8D1zT2w1NCqjmb7B1XKHRYc5T`)**.

## Machine-Readable Discovery & Freemium Status (`$0.00 USD`)

- [Freemium `$0.00` Catalog & Health Status (`GET /v1/free-catalog-status`)](https://jesleytassili-glitch.github.io/b2b-quant-mcp-n8n-suite/v1/free-catalog-status): Free discovery ping for x402 and MCP crawlers (`x-price-usd: 0.0`, `x-402-free-tier: true`).
- [OpenAPI 3.1.0 Specification (`/openapi.json`)](https://jesleytassili-glitch.github.io/b2b-quant-mcp-n8n-suite/openapi.json): 31 paid `POST /v1/x402/{slug}` routes + 1 free `GET /v1/free-catalog-status` route.
- [MCP Server Discovery Manifest (`/.well-known/mcp.json`)](https://jesleytassili-glitch.github.io/b2b-quant-mcp-n8n-suite/.well-known/mcp.json): Official Model Context Protocol server and 31-tool registry.
- [x402 Solana USDC Discovery Manifest (`/.well-known/x402.json`)](https://jesleytassili-glitch.github.io/b2b-quant-mcp-n8n-suite/.well-known/x402.json): Native Solana Mainnet USDC (`DuaKjymBXrmawGgg5gK8D1zT2w1NCqjmb7B1XKHRYc5T`) payment challenges.
- [A2A AgentCard Manifest (`/.well-known/agent.json`)](https://jesleytassili-glitch.github.io/b2b-quant-mcp-n8n-suite/.well-known/agent.json): Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol capability card.
- [Full LLM Technical Reference (`/llms-full.txt`)](https://jesleytassili-glitch.github.io/b2b-quant-mcp-n8n-suite/llms-full.txt): Complete schemas, JSON payloads, MCP configs, and cURL examples for all 31 tools.

## Detailed Technical Specifications for All 31 B2B Engines

### 01. Brazil Gov Procurement & Bidding Radar (PNCP API + MCP Server) (`b2b-quant-apis/b2b-gov-procurement-pncp-radar`)
- **Description:** Extracts, filters, and enriches live Brazilian government public tenders (Pregão Eletrônico, Dispensa - Lei 14.133) from the official PNCP API with item-level pricing, ME/EPP flags, and LLM-ready RAG Markdown briefs.
- **Pay-Per-Event Billing:** `$0.03 USD` per `tender-analyzed`
- **Apify Store URL:** https://apify.com/b2b-quant-apis/b2b-gov-procurement-pncp-radar
- **Sync REST Endpoint:** `POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/b2b-quant-apis~b2b-gov-procurement-pncp-radar/run-sync-get-dataset-items`
- **x402 Solana USDC Endpoint:** `POST https://jesleytassili-glitch.github.io/b2b-quant-mcp-n8n-suite/v1/x402/b2b-gov-procurement-pncp-radar` (PayTo: `DuaKjymBXrmawGgg5gK8D1zT2w1NCqjmb7B1XKHRYc5T`)
- **MCP Streamable HTTP:** `https://mcp.apify.com/?actors=b2b-quant-apis/b2b-gov-procurement-pncp-radar`
- **Input Schema Fields:** `uf, keywords, codigoModalidadeContratacao, dataInicial, dataFinal, maxResults, fetchItems`
- **Output Dataset Fields:** ``
- **Sample JSON Input:**
```json
{
  "keywords": [
    "software",
    "cloud",
    "licenciamento"
  ],
  "uf": "SP",
  "max_results": 10
}
```
